items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: Nearly every afternoon, I and some of the other musicians would meet Bishop, Sammy and some of the German musicians at a sidewalk café where we would talk some trash as all cats do when they get together

ctx.x: But we met a nice young couple who was planning to get married soon, Hildchen and Gunter Kwiatkowsky, who invited us in their parents' home and also introduced us to some of their friends. Sometimes, we were invited by some of them or went out in some keller. Colgone had been very heavily bombed and it was quite a sad sight to see.

Nearly every afternoon, I and some of the other musicians would meet Bishop, Sammy and some of the German musicians at a sidewalk café where we would talk some trash as all cats do when they get together, and one day,Bishop told me a story about Sammy concerning his getting high on a certain German made cigarette. The way Bishop told the tale, it seems that Sammy liked to pick up on some gage now and then, but for a certain time, he had not been able to find the stuff. So he bought a package of cigarette one day,…
